description: Joel Costello is a personal trainer from Bondi beach, Australia. He’s been in the fitness industry for 14 years and has worked with hundreds of people throughout his career, including sports stars like Adam Goodes and Amanda Bisk, as well as dozens of lawyers, mums, entrepreneurs, actors, architects, marketing executives, teachers, bankers, engineers, students, doctors, TV personalities and even other personal trainers Alongside his personal training business, Joel also works for one of the largest commercial gyms in the country. His job is to design the programming and recruit the staff to run the club’s HIIT training programs, educate and coach their team to grow their own PT businesses, as well as run 6-week challenges and team-based fitness events. In his spare time, Joel also runs fitness fundraisers for local charities and weekend health retreats. Combine his professional experience with his own personal fat loss journey, and the success he’s had with hundreds of his clients, Joel' knows what works, and what doesn’t! CUSTOMISED TRAINING PROGRAMS Every program is custom-built and meticulously designed to fit your lifestyle and goals - we use a detailed program design form to investigate your current wellness regime, weekly schedule and health habits to build the perfect lifestyle and workout plan for you and your unique circumstances. - BUILT AROUND YOU - You may already do yoga once a week, see a personal trainer twice a week or attend HIIT classes three times a week? Allow us to build you a structured program to complement these already established healthy habits, and improve your results even further. - 6 WEEK PHASES - We strategically update your program every 6 weeks to eliminate boredom and plateauing and increase adherence, consistency and results. You’ll automatically receive an email containing a program review form at the 4-week mark of phase that is used to refine, improve and update your program. - TRAIN ANYWHERE, ANYTIME - For your convenience, you can access your program from your smartphone, via our app, so you can perform your workouts anywhere at any time. In a busy world, being able to access, track and complete your workouts at a time that suits you is imperative in improving consistency and momentum. - TRACK YOUR PROGRESS - Our programs are formatted in a calendar-style layout via our training app. Check-in each day and complete your daily tasks and workouts, track your progress and results through our stat tracking and progress pictures. Seeing improvements is one of the greatest motivators for long term success. - VIDEO TUTORIALS - To improve results, increase mastery and confidence and prevent injury, every exercise in our programs comes with a technique tutorial video, which you can watch on your smartphone, to ensure you are performing each exercise optimally and getting the most from your workouts. - EFFICIENT, FUN & MOTIVATING - We understand that people are busy and that initial motivation can wane over time, this is why we ensure our workouts are engaging, enjoyable and time-efficient. Our plans are based on science but we know that variety and fun can lead to enjoyment and program consistency which generates results. - MADE BY A PROFESSIONAL - Our programs are results-driven and based on proven methodologies, designed by a career personal trainer. Backed by science and experience, our programs are structured in a format that is engaging, convenient and purposeful. CONTINUOUS CUSTOM UPDATES We love to see our clients grow and improve. We give 24\7 support and encourage you to request changes, updates and tweaks to your program at any time, simply email us with your request and we will update your program. Download our app today!

description:
In our mobile application, physiotherapy exercises for low back, neck, knee, posture and foot area are shown. These exercises are selected from the therapeutic movements that everyone can do. There is no harm in doing these movements. If you have a diagnosed physical condition, you should do this under the supervision of a doctor.

You can start performing these physical therapy exercises with less repetitions and increase the number of exercises over time.


The physiotherapy exercises shown in our application are as follows:


* Neck exercises (You can get rid of this situation called neck stiffness with stretching and isometric movements, which we often encounter in the morning)

* Low back pain exercises (I think there are not many people in the world who do not experience low back pain. These exercises applied in chronic low back pain and herniated disc will improve your quality of life)

* Knee pain exercises (Except for sudden injuries, the load on our knee increases as age progresses and weight increases. These movements should be on the side of mind of everyone who cares about knee health.)

* Shoulder exercises (When we force our arm or shoulder, some discomfort occurs. We show the movements done in their rehabilitation.)

* Posture exercises (These are movements that should be known by both healthy and uncomfortable individuals. It is important for our body to look more upright and smooth.)

* Foot exercises (There may be some congenital or later foot problems. The exercises we show will provide relief.)

description:
Get faster with science-backed training from TrainerRoad. Every indoor workout a rider completes using the TrainerRoad app is based on power and calibrated to their personal fitness level. Along with a vast library of structured workouts, cyclists get access to training plans that tell them exactly what to do to achieve their unique fitness and race goals. It’s power-based training in its most sophisticated and guided form.

What you get when you sign up for TrainerRoad: 

• Live performance data that guides you while you train
• Access to a library of structured power-based workouts
• A Career page to track your progress & view critical ride data
• Science-backed training plans designed to help you achieve your specific cycling goals. 
• All plans are custom created by Level I USAC certified coach Chad Timmerman

Equipment to Get Started Training with Power
TrainerRoad is compatible with the majority of trainers and training devices on the market. To get started training with power, riders can choose from one of three convenient training setups. To check if your equipment is compatible with TrainerRoad, visit the Equipment Checker at https://www.trainerroad.com/equipment-checker.

Have a question for us? We’re here to help! 
Get in touch with us at support@trainerroad.com.

TrainerRoad memberships are $19.95/month or $189/year. Sign up now at www.trainerroad.com.


——————————————
REQUIREMENTS
TrainerRoad for Android supports the most popular flagship Android devices
OS: Android 7 Nougat and higher
Connection: Bluetooth Smart, ANT+ and ANT+ FE-C

NOTES
TrainerRoad for Android supports Bluetooth Smart, ANT+ and ANT+ FEC. Some devices are ANT+ compatible on their own, but may require ANT plugins installed from the Google Play store before they’re ready to use. Other devices may require an ANT+ adapter. Fortunately, some of these devices work with existing ANT+ adapters from your computer and an additional USB-C or phone-specific USB adapter.

Given the various ways TrainerRoad for Android communicates via ANT+, some devices may have stronger signals than others. If you’re having difficulty using a native ANT+ device, you may need an adapter to train normally.
summary: Get Faster with TrainerRoad for Android.

description:
NOCD offers online OCD therapy and in-between session support, right in the NOCD platform. Get matched with a licensed OCD therapist in your state and do live, face-to-face video sessions with a therapist trained in exposure and response prevention (ERP) therapy, the gold standard treatment for OCD. NOCD was created by people with OCD, along with some of the world's top experts.


Online therapy sessions with an OCD specialist:
- Match with an OCD therapist who fits your preferences
- Personalize your OCD treatment plan
- Do live video sessions with a therapist who specializes in exposure and response prevention (ERP) therapy, the gold standard treatment for OCD

Additional support between sessions:
- Use OCD therapy tools 24/7
- Message your therapist anytime
- Interact with a community who knows what you’re going through
- Dozens of weekly support groups with others in NOCD Therapy


WHAT IS OBSESSIVE COMPULSIVE DISORDER (OCD)?

OCD is a common psychiatric disorder that involves repetitive, unwanted thoughts that cause anxiety, and compulsive behaviors done in an attempt to reduce this anxiety. Commonly misunderstood as nothing more than a personality quirk, OCD usually involves intense distress and can become completely debilitating when left untreated.


IS NOCD THERAPY EFFECTIVE?

NOCD live video therapy has been shown to be as effective as face-to-face therapy. Our model has been backed by research from the Columbia University Medical Center, which found a reduction in OCD severity by an average of 40% in 8 weeks of NOCD Therapy.


WHO ARE NOCD THERAPISTS?

NOCD’s extensive therapist network includes licensed counselors, psychologists, and social workers. Every NOCD Therapist receives specialty training in exposure and response prevention (ERP) therapy, the most effective OCD treatment. All NOCD therapists are managed by our clinical leadership team of experts who have 20+ years of experience treating OCD and have designed some of the world’s top OCD treatment programs.


IS NOCD SECURE?

Our services are powered by AWS and Aptible, both of which are fully SOC2 and HIPAA compliant. Your therapy data is stored in our EHR that also complies with all HIPAA requirements. All medical notes and records are only accessible by you and your therapist. Furthermore, in addition to internal privacy safeguards, we regularly enlist security researchers to assess our services for vulnerabilities. For more information, find our complete Privacy Policy at https://www.treatmyocd.com/privacy-policy/, and Terms of Use at https://www.treatmyocd.com/terms/


Download the NOCD app today and schedule a free phone call with our care team to learn how we can help you regain your life from OCD.
